prompts.waves:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: production HAIR-ONLY sprite atlas for an existing chibi doll dress-up game, not a concept poster. Input image 1 is the LOCKED original Coco head turnaround and its exact coordinate/layout guide. Match its soft chestnut brown, painterly satin strands, warm broad highlights, rounded toy-like sculpting and gentle shading; no photoreal wig, no sharp spikes, no oily hard highlights. Replace the bob hair with the requested NEW design. Output ONLY the new hair with ribbons, on real transparent background: remove ALL face, eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, skin, ears, neck, clothes, body and reference bob. Face openings must be fully transparent, not white or peach. Shape the hair around the exact existing Coco face; do not shrink, enlarge or move the face opening.
OUTPUT LAYOUT: one square 1536x1536 atlas, precisely 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows, each cell 512 wide x768 high. Top left FRONT, top middle FRONT-RIGHT 45 DEGREE, top right RIGHT PROFILE (nose would point right), bottom left BACK-RIGHT 135 DEGREE, bottom middle BACK; bottom right completely transparent unused. Match these reference positions exactly. Every head's skull stays in the TOP HALF of its own cell: head crown roughly y20, eyes would be y270, chin y356, neck y370 (coordinates local to each cell). Do not vertically center the subjects in the 768-high cells. Keep face holes exactly in the reference location. Front opening leaves eyes at (186,271) and (330,271), nose (256,296), tiny smile (256,321) CLEAR. Bangs can end at y210 but must not cover eyes. Profile and diagonal holes follow reference. All five angles must be the SAME 3D-consistent hairstyle and same hair length, same bands/ribbons, same strand masses. No dividers, no labels, no text, no fake checkerboard, no drop shadows on background. Keep each silhouette within its cell, no touching neighbors. Preserve generous transparent space below each head.
NEW DESIGN: A plush romantic doll's shoulder-length big soft S-wave hairstyle. Airy side-parted curtain fringe, two or three broad pillowy waves per side, rounded curled-under ends reaching local y510. Crown and roots snugly fit the Coco skull; lower hair is fluffy but not an oversized wig. Hair sides frame rather than hide the cheeks; entire visible face stays open. One tiny dusty-rose velvet ribbon nestled symmetrically on each side near the temples, subtle ribbons, not giant bows. Much gentler larger waves than tight ringlets, sculpted soft brown painted locks. Make a fresh silhouette, not the reference bob extended with ringlets. Front hair max width~470px, x20..492. The middle gap under the face/neck should stay transparent.
